about: How a film ends (tools/ci/ending.mjs). The owner, 2026-09-29: people forget to follow the page, so some films end on a follow reminder instead of the closing quote. The owner, 2026-10-02: every SECOND film from v63, and the line now first asks to comment the keyword „ვინარი“ for the link (the page sends the app's link in a DM), then to follow. Film number n (the v<n>- of its id) is a follow film when n >= from and (n - from) % every == 0 (v63, v65, v67 ...); a redo keeps its original's ending, and a film already made keeps the one it was made with. Its EndCard tagline and last spoken line are exactly one line of "follow", never one of the last "recent" distinct lines earlier films ended on, with no VINARI+ or price note under it. A line asks to follow the page, never to subscribe to the app: "გამოწერა" alone is also VINARI+, so a line says "გამოგვიწერე" (us) or names the page. Keep a line to about 52 letters (4.5 s of voice), each card row (between the "|") to 34 characters, informal შენ, no em dash, never "download" or a store name (build-index CTA). A line taken out of the bank moves to "retired", so the films that used it still count as follow films. "postLine" is the first paragraph of every film's post text, put there by tools/ci/publish.mjs (never by the spec), the owner 2026-10-02.
follow: დაწერე „ვინარი“ კომენტარში, | ლინკს მოგწერთ. და გამოგვიწერე.
„ვინარი“ დაწერე კომენტარში, | ლინკს მოგწერთ. გვერდიც გამოიწერე.
postLine: დაწერე კომენტარში „ვინარი“ და აპის ლინკს პირადში გამოგიგზავნით.

freeWeek.about: The free-week line (the owner, 2026-10-19: "films may say now and then that you can download it and try it free for a week"; true for first-time subscribers of VINARI+). THE ONE SWITCH: "on": false takes it out of every new film and Story set, and the call-to-action rule (tools/ci/words.mjs CTA, PUSHY) is strict again everywhere; films already made keep what they said. Film number n says it when on, n >= from, (n - from) % every == 0 and n is not a follow film (tools/ci/ending.mjs freeWeekFilm: v110, v114, v118 ...): one line of "lines", word for word, as the whole beat right before the EndCard (its say, and its show if any), never in the cover, the post, the EndCard line or a scene's text. A Story set may end on one as its end slide's body. Keep a line short (about 3 s), informal შენ, no em dash, no "!", never "now" or "today" (no urgency). tools/ci/ending.mjs --test checks the rule.
